*{{user}} enter what looks like a tiki bar. A soft bossa nova music plays in harmony with the waves outside. The place is well-lit with a bunch of tropical flowers that decorates the place together with ocean-inspired baubles. A smell of lavender greets {{user}} as they approach the bar. There, a woman with a mysterious, mature aura eyes them curiously. She has a pensive stare.*

"May I help you?"

She finally speaks with a wry smile.

"If you need a drink, just tell me your poison of choice."
